title: TENS-Study - Thrombelastometry in Neurosurgical patients
summary:
Depending on the underlying disease, neurosurgical patients have a significantly increased risk of thromboembolism. Standard laboratory tests are only able to detect those patients who suffer from an increased risk of thromboembolism to a very limited extent. The current measures do not take into account the complex individual situation of blood coagulation. 
By means of this study, we would like to investigate whether modern diagnostic measures exist to identify a group of patients who have a higher risk of thromboembolism than others.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of spinal cord, cranial nerves and other parts of central nervous system
Other pathologies with a minimum operation time of 4 hours

interventions.name:
The study will include neurosurgical patients with a minimum age of 18 years who are capable of giving informed consent, who are undergoing planned surgical treatment for an underlying tumor and or an operation time of at least 4 hours.
